hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how Shifa Technologies collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our website.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Shifa Technologies is committed to protecting your privacy. By using our website, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

informationCollection.title: Information We Collect
informationCollection.content: We may collect personal information such as your name, phone number, email address, company name, and any details you provide when submitting an inquiry through our contact form.

informationUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
informationUsage.content: We use your information to respond to inquiries, provide product information, improve our services, and communicate with you regarding our products and services.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: Our website may use cookies to improve your browsing experience and analyze website traffic. You may disable cookies through your browser settings if you prefer.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We may use trusted third-party services, such as website hosting, analytics, and contact form providers, to help operate our website. These providers only process information necessary to deliver their services.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us using the details provided on our Contact page.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

contactCard.title: Need Help?
contactCard.description: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact our team.
